interpretation: Grid-proxy residual at one site: station (native mesh point) versus a 2.5 km GRIB2 cell, minus VDatum. It mixes datum-conversion differences with station-versus-cell differences and cannot by itself be read as a datum difference. Across 115 STOFS-3D stations the same residual has a median of +0.0001 m (step 5e), so the Boston value is a station-versus-cell residual (inner harbour; one wet cell within 3 km), not a datum difference. The 5.3 and 5.5 km cells are compared with the same Boston series, so they do not corroborate it independently.
